description: Read your Fathom Analytics traffic and event reports and live visitor counts, manage sites, event currencies and milestones, and start workflows when a site, event, page or referring site is new, when an event is completed, or when traffic reaches a number you set.

fathom_analytics_current_visitors_trigge.description: Runs when the number of people on a site right now reaches the number you set, such as a traffic spike. It runs at most once an hour while traffic stays that high.

output.current_visitors: How many people were on the site

parameters.description: The Fathom site to watch.
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.description: Run when at least this many people are on the site at once.
parameters.name: threshold

fathom_analytics_event_completed_trigger.description: Runs when an event, such as a sign-up or purchase, is completed. Fathom gives counts, not each completion, so several completions between two checks start one run.

output.date: Today's date, in the site's time zone
output.value_today: Value so far today, in cents

parameters.description: The Fathom site to watch.
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.description: The event to watch, by name.
parameters.name: event_name

fathom_analytics_new_event_trigger.description: Runs when a site starts tracking an event it hasn't before, such as a new sign-up or purchase event. Events already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.currency: The currency set for it, empty for the site's default
output.event: Everything Fathom says about the event

parameters.description: The Fathom site to watch.
parameters.name: site_id

fathom_analytics_new_page_trigger.description: Runs when a page on a site gets visits for the first time since the workflow was turned on, such as a page you just published. Pages visited since the start of yesterday when it is turned on don't start it.

output.counted_since: Start of the counting window, in the site's time zone

parameters.description: The Fathom site to watch.
parameters.name: site_id

fathom_analytics_new_referrer_trigger.description: Runs when visitors arrive from a site that hasn't sent any since the workflow was turned on, such as a new link to you. Sites that referred visitors since the start of yesterday when it is turned on don't start it.

output.counted_since: Start of the counting window, in the site's time zone
output.referrer: The referring site, such as news.ycombinator.com

parameters.description: The Fathom site to watch.
parameters.name: site_id

fathom_analytics_new_site_trigger.description: Runs when a site is added to your Fathom account. Sites already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.name: Its name
output.site: Everything Fathom says about the site
output.site_id: The site's ID, the code its tracking script uses
output.time_zone: The time zone its reports use

fathom_analytics_traffic_threshold_trigg.description: Runs once a day (or once an hour) when a site's visits or pageviews so far that day (or hour), in the site's time zone, reach the number you set.

output.metric: What was counted: visits, pageviews or uniques
output.period_start: When the day or hour began, in the site's time zone

parameters.description: The Fathom site to watch.
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.description: Run when the total reaches this number.
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.description: What to count. Defaults to visits.
parameters.name: metric

parameters.description: Today's total or this hour's. Defaults to today.
parameters.name: period
